provider_receipt.summary: Named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-88 MemoryStore::store only serializes a MemoryRecord and discards it, so scan_vault performs no persistent memory ingestion despite the stated interface purpose. (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 requires an obsolete frontmatter shape, including numeric confidence, and cannot deserialize the active contract documented in docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93, which requires authority, privacy, source_type, review status, and string confidence. (3) src/lib.rs:107-125 ingests every Markdown file as semantic memory without enforcing authority, status, privacy, quarantine, or review requirements, contrary to the private-by-default classification contract. (4) src/lib.rs:184-192 allows absolute and parent-relative wikilinks to resolve outside the vault and returns those external paths when they exist. (5) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards traversal errors, permitting incomplete scans to be reported as successful. The parent receipt validly supports only the declared clean-tree check; it provides no correctness, security, privacy, or functional verification evidence for these behaviors.
